themes.name: Digital Municipal Access
themes.rule: Proposals that improve access to municipal information or services through digital channels, connectivity, assisted digital help, or public data.

themes.name: Affordable and Efficient Housing
themes.rule: Proposals that create, preserve, regulate, make transparent, or improve the affordability and energy performance of housing.

themes.name: Education and School Support
themes.rule: Proposals that improve school learning, teaching conditions, pupil support, school meals, or publicly funded education and training.

themes.name: Culture and Public Libraries
themes.rule: Proposals that expand residents' access to cultural events, arts, museums, or library services.

themes.name: Environmental Sustainability and Green Space
themes.rule: Proposals that reduce pollution or waste, conserve energy and resources, monitor environmental conditions, or create green public spaces.

themes.name: Public Transport and Active Travel
themes.rule: Proposals that improve transit affordability, frequency, information, late-night access, cycling infrastructure, or street safety for walking and travel.

themes.name: Neighborhood Safety and Emergency Response
themes.rule: Proposals that prevent crime, improve public-space security, strengthen community policing, improve safety lighting, or shorten emergency response times.

themes.name: Health and Care Access
themes.rule: Proposals that expand preventive, primary, specialist, mental-health, or in-home care services for residents.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Small Business
themes.rule: Proposals that develop workers' skills, promote local hiring, support independent workers, simplify business administration, or finance local businesses.
